audit.chain_ok: Audit chain intact — {n} sealed events verified (last hash {h}…).
camera.no_frame: No image yet: the core is starting, or the camera is unreachable.
camera.preview_alt: Live camera stream with the analysis overlay
camera.preview_hint: Boxes, track numbers and names are drawn by the analysis in progress.
camera.probe_hint: Uses the camera account of the Secrets; takes up to 15 s.
help.api.idle_timeout_minutes: A session with no user action during this delay is closed (automatic status refresh and the video stream do not count as activity).
help.api.session_hours: Beyond this, the session is closed even if active.
help.camera.hw_accel: H.264 decoding on the Intel GPU (auto: when vainfo reports H.264 decoding).
help.camera.reconnect_delay_s: Wait before reconnecting after the stream is lost.
help.camera.rtsp_url: rtsp://<camera>:554/<path> of the stream analyzed by Jarvis (H.264 recommended: the Haswell GPU does not decode H.265). Put the account in Secrets > Camera account / password, not in the URL: it is injected at connection time. Use "Test the stream" below before saving.
help.commands.open_phrases: Spoken after the wake word, one phrase per line (Vosk grammar).
help.commands.strict: Accept only the phrases above, spoken after the wake word (no keyword guessing).
help.decision.auth_window_s: After an authorized person is recognized, the green LED stays on for this time, then turns off; voice commands ("Jarvis… ouvre la porte du garage" / "Jarvis… ferme la porte du garage") are accepted only during this window. A new recognition extends it.
help.decision.greeting: Phrase spoken at the first recognition of the day; {first_name} is replaced by the first name.
help.decision.led_on_s: On-time of the LED for a garage pulse, an unknown face or a watchlisted person.
help.decision.listen_after_recognition_s: Listening time without the wake word after the greeting (0 = disabled).
help.decision.unknown_message: Phrase spoken to an unknown visitor (empty = no message).
help.decision.voice_only_after_recogniti: Ignore the microphone outside the recognition window (recommended).
help.decision.watchlist_message: Phrase spoken when a watchlisted person is recognized (empty = no message).
help.detector.conf: "Person" detections below this confidence are ignored.
help.detector.device: auto follows the hardware detection; intel:gpu needs a Gen9+ Intel GPU (not the Haswell HD 4600).
help.detector.imgsz: 480 by default, 416 on a dual-core CPU (the OpenVINO model must be re-exported).
help.faces.adaptive_enabled: Automatically adds the best captures of a confidently recognized person.
help.faces.adaptive_max_per_person: Cap on automatic additions per person.
help.faces.adaptive_min_quality: Minimum capture quality (detection x size x sharpness, from 0 to 1).
help.faces.adaptive_min_score: Minimum similarity to learn a capture (well above the recognition threshold).
help.faces.adaptive_novelty_max_similari: A capture closer than this to an existing photo adds nothing and is ignored.
help.faces.match_threshold: Minimum ArcFace cosine similarity to match a face to a person. 0.40 lenient, 0.45 balanced, 0.55 strict.
help.faces.max_faces_per_frame: CPU budget: maximum number of faces analyzed per frame (the target first).
help.faces.min_det_score: Minimum confidence of the SCRFD detector.
help.faces.min_face_px: Shortest side of the face in pixels; smaller captures are ignored.
help.faces.min_sharpness: Minimum variance of the Laplacian (blurry images are ignored).
help.faces.recheck_interval_s: Minimum delay between two face analyses of the same track.
help.faces.search_threshold: Minimum similarity of the sightings returned by a photo search.
help.faces.unknown_after_observations: Number of unmatched observations before a face is declared unknown.
help.faces.unknown_cluster_similarity: Above this, a new unknown face joins the cluster of the closest visitor.
help.faces.unknown_dedupe_similarity: Above this, an unknown visitor seen again within the deduplication window is not stored again.
help.faces.unknown_dedupe_window_s: Time during which the same unknown visitor is stored only once.
help.faces.votes_required: Number of consistent observations of the same track before the person is considered recognized.
help.hardware.pulse_ms: Contact closure time (the Novoferm manual calls for a short pulse).
help.log_level: DEBUG is very verbose; INFO is suitable for production.
help.logging.file_enabled: Writes the log of both services to a file, in addition to journald.
help.logging.rotate_mode: "size": as soon as the file exceeds the maximum size; "daily": every day at midnight.
help.logging.syslog_enabled: Also sends the log to an rsyslog / syslog-ng server (RFC 3164).
help.logging.syslog_facility: Category used to sort messages on the server side.
help.monitoring.log_shipper: Agent that pushes /var/log/jarvis/*.log and journald to Loki. Grafana has deprecated Promtail in favor of Alloy.
help.monitoring.metrics_enabled: Exposes Jarvis metrics (vision, camera, sightings, sessions, audit, disk). Network access requires a Bearer token.
help.monitoring.node_exporter_enabled: Enables the Prometheus node_exporter agent (CPU, memory, disk, network) on port 9100.
help.mqtt.allow_commands: Garage pulse, PTZ home and speech from the smart-home controller. Every command must carry the MQTT command token; keep the broker authenticated, encrypted and restricted by ACLs.
help.mqtt.enabled: Publishes states and events to an MQTT broker: Home Assistant, openHAB, Domoticz, Jeedom, Node-RED.
help.mqtt.ha_discovery: Creates the Jarvis device and its entities in Home Assistant automatically.
help.mqtt.host: Name or IP address of the MQTT broker.
help.notifications.webhook_url: URL called with a JSON POST (Home Assistant, Node-RED, ntfy...). Empty = disabled.
help.performance.mode: auto: at start-up, pick the inference devices, providers, hardware decoding and rates that suit the detected hardware (only for settings you did not set); manual: use the configuration as is.
help.plates.approach_growth: Growth of the vehicle box over 2 s meaning "approaching" (1.15 = +15 %).
help.plates.auto_close: DANGER: an unattended closing door can hurt. Closes only when the door sensor reads "open" and the camera saw nobody (no person, no vehicle) during the whole delay; the motor's obstacle detection and a photocell must work.
help.plates.auto_open: Open the garage when a vehicle with a known, enabled plate approaches and the door sensor reads "closed" (the plate's person must be allowed at that time).
help.plates.close_delay_s: The scene must stay empty for this long; any presence restarts the countdown.
help.plates.enabled: Track vehicles and read their plates (fast-alpr, offline). Needs the plate models: run "jarvis setup-models" once after enabling.
help.plates.leave_shrink: Shrinkage of the vehicle box over 2 s meaning "leaving" (0.85 = -15 %).
help.plates.min_confidence: Mean OCR confidence required for a read to count.
help.plates.min_vehicle_px: Vehicles smaller than this in the image are not read (plate too small).
help.plates.read_interval_s: Per vehicle; lower = faster confirmation, more CPU.
help.plates.unknown_notify: Send a notification (webhook, MQTT) for unknown, disabled or expired plates.
help.plates.votes_required: Number of identical reads of the same vehicle before the plate is trusted.
help.ptz.deadzone: Tolerated offset around the center (fraction of the frame).
help.ptz.host: IP address or host name of the camera ONVIF service (usually the camera itself).
help.ptz.port: HTTP port of the ONVIF service (80, 8000 or 8080 depending on the vendor).
help.ptz.profile_index: Index of the media profile carrying the PTZ configuration.
help.ptz.return_home_after_s: Delay without a target before returning.
help.ptz.target_height_ratio: Target height of the person, as a fraction of the frame.
help.ptz.zoom_enabled: Zoom in to enlarge the tracked person.
help.recording.enabled: Writes an MP4 clip (with pre-roll) when one of the selected events occurs.
help.recording.max_total_gb: The oldest clips are deleted beyond this size.
help.recording.post_seconds: Recording continues after the last trigger.
help.recording.triggers: Events that start or extend a clip.
help.secrets.camera_username: Account created on the camera for Jarvis.
help.secrets.loki_username: Basic authentication of the Loki push endpoint.
help.secrets.metrics_token: Bearer token required on /metrics from the network (generated automatically when empty).
help.secrets.mqtt_command_token: Shared secret that every MQTT command payload must carry: {"token": "…"}.
help.secrets.mqtt_username: Account of Jarvis on the MQTT broker.
help.secrets.picovoice_access_key: Only needed for the Porcupine « jarvis » wake word.
help.secrets.webhook_token: Sent as « Authorization: Bearer » with each notification (ntfy, Node-RED…).
help.simulation.drive_relay: DANGER: when on, a garage pulse decided during a simulation (simulated camera, face or voice) really drives the relay. Off: the pulse is only logged as garage_pulse_simulated.
help.simulation.loop: Restart the simulated video at its end (otherwise its last frame stays on screen).
help.simulation.require_window: Simulated voice commands obey the live rule: a person must have been recognized within the recognition window (simulate one first). Off: test the voice chain alone.
help.speaker.enabled: Requires the voice to match the recognized person (the ECAPA model must be installed).
help.storage.event_retention_days: Retention period for the event log and the audit trail.
help.storage.plate_read_retention_days: Plate reads and their vehicle snapshots are deleted after this delay.
help.storage.sighting_retention_days: Retention period for timestamped sightings and their photos.
help.ui.language: Default language of the interface and the login screen (each user can change it for themselves from the menu).
help.vision.preview_fps: Frames per second of the Live tab stream.
help.vision.preview_width: Width in pixels of the image streamed to the Live tab.
help.vision.process_fps: Maximum rate of the vision pipeline.
help.wakeword.threshold: Minimum openWakeWord score; lower = more sensitive, more false triggers.
live.garage_confirm: Send a pulse to the garage door?
live.garage_sent: Pulse sent to the garage door.
live.ptz_sent: Camera returning to its home position.
login.expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.expired_idle: You were signed out after a period of inactivity.
login.file_mode: This page is served by the Jarvis appliance: open https://jarvis.local/ (or the address of the mini-PC). Opened as a local file, sign-in is not possible.
login.hero_text: Real-time person tracking, face recognition and spoken commands — processed locally, never sent to the cloud.
login.subtitle: Jarvis administration console
login.title: Sign in
login.unreachable: The Jarvis service is not answering. Check that jarvis-api is running.
logs.empty: No log entry matches these filters.
logs.session_end: The live log stopped: the session ended.
logs.truncated: older matches not shown: narrow the search
menu.idle: Automatic sign-out after {n} min of inactivity.
monitoring.hint: Prometheus scrapes /metrics over HTTPS with this bearer token. Local scrapers on 127.0.0.1:8000 need no token.
monitoring.rotate_confirm: Generate a new token? Prometheus must be updated with it.
monitoring.title: Monitoring access
password.changed_revoked: Password changed. {n} other session(s) signed out.
password.forced: The initial password must be replaced before you can use Jarvis.
password.rule_common: Not the user name or a default word (admin, password, jarvis)
password.title: Change your password
people.counts: {f} face photo(s), {a} learned automatically · {v} voice profile(s)
people.delete_confirm: Delete {name} and all related data (photos, voice, sightings)?
plates.delete_confirm: Delete the plate {p}? Its past reads are kept.
plates.disabled: License plate recognition is disabled: enable it in Settings > License plates, then run "jarvis setup-models".
plates.label: Label
plates.no_reads: No plate read matches these filters.
plates.registry_hint: A known plate on an approaching vehicle opens the garage (door sensor required).
rules.both_times: Enter both a start and an end time, or neither.
rules.title: Access rules
search.drop: Drop a photo or choose a file
search.hint: The photo is only used for the search and is never stored. The date and time filters above apply.
search.title: Search by face
set.plates.auto_close: Close after a known vehicle left
set.stt.listen_timeout_s: Listening time after the wake word
set.stt.max_utterance_s: Max. duration analyzed for the speaker
settings.restart_confirm: Restart the Jarvis core service now? Tracking stops for a few seconds.
settings.restart_needed: Some changes take effect after a service restart.
settings.secret_cleared: The value will be cleared when you save.
sim.camera_title: Play a file instead of the camera
sim.no_media: No video or photo yet: add one above.
sim.no_preview: Choose a video or a photo and press Play: the analysis runs on it as on a live camera.
sim.relay_note: Garage pulses decided during a simulation are only logged (garage_pulse_simulated) unless "Simulations drive the relay" is on.
sim.upload_media: Add a video or a photo
sim.window_closed: not opened (person not allowed or outside their access rules)
sim.window_open: open for {n} s (green LED, voice commands)
visitors.delete_confirm: Delete every image of this visitor?
visitors.hint: Unrecognized visitors, grouped automatically when the same face comes back. Assigning a group to a person also identifies all of their past sightings.
visitors.name: Visitor #{n}
voice.instructions: Read a natural sentence for 10 seconds, in a quiet place — for example: “Jarvis, open the garage. Hello, I am coming home.”
